name: CCA 512 发动机失效 积冰/防冰 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CCA 512, you are at Wuhan Airport, parking at gate 211, you have got information V, request ATC clearance to Changsha from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 CCA 512，位于 Wuhan Airport，停在 211 号登机口，已收到信息 V，向武汉放行请求前往 Changsha 的 ATC 许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA 512, gate 211, information V, request ATC clearance to Changsha.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CCA 512，211 号登机口，信息 V，请求前往 Changsha 的 ATC 许可。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 512, cleared to Changsha via flight planned route, LK Oscar02D, initial climb 1,800 meters, cruising level 8400 meters, Runway 04, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 2016.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CCA 512，许可按飞行计划航路飞往长沙，执行 LKO-02D 离场，初始爬升至 1,800 米，巡航高度 8400 米，Runway 04，离场频率 119.7，应答机 2016。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Changsha via flight planned route, LKO-02 departure, initial climb 1800 meters, cruising level 8400 meters, Runway 04, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 2016, CCA 512.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往长沙，执行 LKO-02 离场，初始爬升至 1800 米，巡航高度 8400 米，Runway 04，离场频率 119.7，应答机 2016，CCA 512。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你准备推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 512, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 512，准备推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 512, push back and start up approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 512，推出和开车批准，机头朝东。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing east, CCA 512.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，机头朝东，CCA 512。

cards.audioText: B: You are now on the taxiway Z4 with engines running, ask Ground control for taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你现在在滑行道 Z4，发动机运转，向地面管制请求滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 512, taxiway Z4, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 512，滑行道 Z4，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 512, taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway Z4 and A, hold short of A4.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 512，经滑行道 Z4 和 A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，在 A4 前等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway Z4 and A, hold short of A4, CCA 512.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4 和 A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，在 A4 前等待，CCA 512。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 512, caution work in progress near the right side of A3.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 512，注意 A3 右侧附近有施工。

cards.audioText: CCA 512, give way to Airbus 3 20 vacating on E3, after traffic is clear, continue taxi via A, hold short of Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 512，给正在 E3 脱离的 Airbus 320 让行，相关航空器通过后，经 A 继续滑行，在 Runway 04 前等待。
cards.referenceText: give way to Airbus 320 traffic in sight, after traffic is clear, continue taxi via A, hold short of Runway 04, CCA 512.
cards.referenceTextZh: 给 Airbus 320 让行，已看到相关航空器，相关航空器通过后，经 A 继续滑行，在 Runway 04 前等待，CCA 512。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne at 900 meters climbing, contact Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已离地，900 米爬升，联系 Wuhan Departure。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CCA 512, airborne, 900 meters climbing.
cards.referenceTextZh: Wuhan Departure，CCA 512，已离地，900 米爬升。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 512, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, turn left, direct to DA, climb to 3000 meters on QNH 1020.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 512，Wuhan Departure，雷达识别，左转，直飞 DA，按 QNH 1020 爬升到 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left, direct to DA, climb to 3000 meters on QNH 1020, CCA 512.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转，直飞 DA，按 QNH 1020 爬升到 3000 米，CCA 512。

cards.audioText: CCA 512, climb to and maintain 6,600 meters, expedite until passing 3900m.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 512，爬升至并保持 6,600 米，加速爬升直至通过 3900m。
cards.referenceText: climb to and maintain 6600 meters, expedite until passing 3900, CCA 512.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至并保持 6600 米，加速爬升直至通过 3900，CCA 512。

cards.audioText: you are experiencing moderate icing while maintaining 6,600 meters, request a higher level and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh: 你在保持 6,600 米时遭遇中度积冰，请求更高的高度并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CCA 512, maintaining 6600 meters, we are encountering moderate icing, request a higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CCA 512，正保持 6600 米，我们遭遇中度积冰，请求更高的高度。

cards.referenceText: climb to and maintain 7200 meters, CCA 512.

cards.audioText: suddenly your starboard engine failed at 7200m, make an urgency call to ATC and request descent and return to Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的右发突然在 7200m 失效，向 ATC 发出紧急呼叫，并请求下降和返回武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Control, CCA 512, our starboard engine failed at 7200 meters, request descent and return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，武汉管制，CCA 512，我们的右发在 7200 米失效，请求下降并返场落地。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 512, roger PAN, descend to 4200 meters, turn left heading 010, expect ILS approach Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 512，收到 PAN，下降到 4200 米，左转航向 010，预计跑道 04 ILS 进近。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 4200 meters, turn left heading 010, expect ILS approach Runway 04, CCA 512.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到 4200 米，左转航向 010，预计跑道 04 ILS 进近，CCA 512。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 512, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1019.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 512，按 QNH 1019 下降到 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1019, CCA 512.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按 QNH 1019 下降到 3000 米，CCA 512。

cards.audioText: you failed to restart the right engine, ask ATC for priority landing and also ask for the longest runway for safety concern.
cards.audioTextZh: 你未能重新启动右发，向 ATC 请求优先落地，并出于安全考虑请求使用最长跑道。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA 512, we failed to restart the right engine, request priority landing and the longest runway at Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA 512，我们未能重新启动右发，请求优先落地并使用武汉机场最长跑道。

cards.audioText: you have established on ILS approach Runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 你已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 512, established on ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 512，已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
